cover.headline:
Everything SYNC Performance knows,
in one place.
cover.lede: A three-phase plan to move SYNC Performance from Monday and scattered Drive folders into one Notion workspace that every department uses, ready for January. Based on our conversations on October 23 and November 17.

glance.p: Every team and AI tool working from the same information.
Three phases in about five weeks.
With training for the whole team.

context.title:
What we
heard.
context.lede: SYNC Performance is an apparel company running ops, sales and product across Monday, Google Drive, Slack, Missive, Shopify and Granola.

stats.t: people on the team by January
Monday boards actively maintained, by your estimate
tools in use: Monday, Drive, Slack, Missive, Shopify and Granola, plus Claude, ChatGPT and Grok

pains.it: "Every little instance of communication doesn't have a central database."
pains.p: Updates live in Slack threads and personal AI chats. When the person who owns an update is out, it doesn't go out, and nobody can ask their AI what the rest of the team did today.

pains.it: "Why is this jacket have this fabric this year and it had this other fabric last year?"
pains.p: Tech packs sit in Drive folders, so answers depend on finding the right file or asking your VP of product directly.

pains.it: "It just feels like we're getting nickel and dimed to pay for all this extra stuff."
pains.p: Pages take forever to load and updates get lost. You pay for the CRM and work management separately, and AI credits on top of that.

quote.text: We see the benefit potential of Notion, but we just haven't been able to allocate enough time to it.

context.opportunity: You and Katie already proved Notion works for your team. Peak season is the right time for us to build the rest, so everyone starts January with their department set up and the training to use it.

focus.title:
What changes
for your team.
focus.statement: One place where everyone on the team, and every AI tool they use, finds the same up-to-date answer.
focus.why: The three phases below are how we get there, in about five weeks.

benefits.p: Each department runs its OKRs, weekly meetings and boards in the same workspace.
The team and customer service look up any product, its tech pack and why it changed.
Notes and recaps are saved after every meeting, whoever runs it.
ChatGPT, Claude or Grok: whichever model each person prefers, it reads the same company context.
You're not tied to one platform's AI. Your team connects the models it already uses.
The boards that run the business live in Notion instead of Monday.

proposal.title:
What we'll build
and what it costs.
proposal.intro: Each phase has its own price and they add up to one fixed total.

phases.name: Information audit and roadmap
phases.summary: We meet each team, map the metrics they need and where they live, and design the workspace around that.

deliverables.p: Up to 6 calls of 30 minutes with your department leads, Katie included.
The metrics each team needs and where they should live.
Each board marked migrate now, move later or archive. You approve the list.
How your teamspaces and databases connect.
What comes next, and how to move the remaining boards.

phases.name: Core workspace, products and migration
phases.summary: Every department working in Notion, your product knowledge in one place, and the critical Monday boards moved over.

deliverables.p: One per department, with its weekly framework and boards.
Goals and meetings in one place, with AI meeting notes.
Every product with its tech pack, specs and why it changed, ready for customer service.
Up to 10 boards moved from Monday with their active records. The CRM too, if the audit confirms Notion fits.
Key sheets linked and searchable by Notion AI.
One shared context for Claude and your other AI tools.

phases.name: Training and launch
phases.summary: Two sessions so you and Katie can run the system, and the team uses it from day one.

deliverables.h: Admin session with Alex and Katie
deliverables.p: How to run and grow the workspace.
Both sessions recorded, plus a one-page guide.

included: A meeting with you and Katie every week
A designated Slack channel with our team for questions during the project
Your current Notion work kept and built on
excluded: AI agents per department and connecting Notion to Slack (on the roadmap, quoted after the audit)
Live syncs with Shopify, Missive or email (defined in the roadmap, subject to technical feasibility)
Moving the "move later" boards (the migration guide shows your team how)
Moving files out of Google Drive (they stay in Drive, linked from Notion)
proposal.guarantee: Two weeks after launch to fix issues within the delivered scope, at no extra cost.

payment.schedule: 50% when you accept (USD 1,750), 50% on delivery (USD 1,750). By bank transfer, or by card through Stripe with a 4% card fee.

next_steps.p: We email you the kickoff link and book the interviews with your leads.
Build through December, training the week of January 4.

closing:
We're ready to build
your Eureka moment.
